// Reference code (not production): generated from Figma "Brownfield Design" > Search & Discover - Viewport by tools/screen_code.py.
// DS names only (Music App Android design system); colors follow the Light / Dark theme.

import androidx.compose.foundation.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.*
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource

@Composable
fun SearchDiscoverViewportScreen(navigate: (String) -> Unit) {
    Scaffold(
        bottomBar = {
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                MiniPlayer(
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5960_10_451),
                    title = "ولا بعد سنين",
                    subtitle = "اليسا",
                    onOpen = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(AppTheme.spacing.spacing4))
                BottomNavigation(
                    firstItem = NavigationItem(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.explore),
                        icon = AppIcons.Explore,
                    ),
                    secondItem = NavigationItem(
                        selected = true,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.search),
                        icon = AppIcons.Search,
                    ),
                    thirdItem = NavigationItem(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.connect),
                        icon = AppIcons.Groups,
                    ),
                    fourthItem = NavigationItem(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.your_library),
                        icon = AppIcons.LibraryMusic,
                    ),
                    onChange = { index -> when (index) { 0 -> navigate("explore-viewport"); 1 -> navigate("search-discover-viewport"); 3 -> navigate("library-music") } },
                )
            }
        },
    ) { innerPadding ->
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(innerPadding)
                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
                .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
        ) {
            StatusBar(time = "11:58", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
            TopAppBar(
                title = stringResource(R.string.search_discover),
                showActions = false,
                onAction = { index -> when (index) { "Profile" -> navigate("profile-full") } },
                onNavigate = { navigate("back") },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
            // Search Section
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(start = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16, top = AppTheme.spacing.spacing8, end = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
            ) {
                SearchBar(
                    placeholder = stringResource(R.string.songs_artists_lyrics_playlists),
                    iconSearch = AppIcons.Search,
                    iconMic = AppIcons.Mic,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            // Radar Section
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(start = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16, top = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16, end = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
            ) {
                Button(
                    style = ButtonStyle.OutlinedAccent,
                    labelText = stringResource(R.string.radar_songs_around_you),
                    showLeadingIcon = true,
                    leadingIcon = AppIcons.Radar,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            // Popular Section
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(start = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16, top = AppTheme.spacing.spacing8, end = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
            ) {
                SectionHeader(
                    title = stringResource(R.string.popular),
                    showMore = false,
                    showSupportingText = false,
                    supportingText = stringResource(R.string.discover_music_based_on_your_recent),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                // Genre Grid
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                ) {
                    GenreCard(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.top),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5936_62_3669),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Blue,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.new_music),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5937_62_3672),
                    )
                }
            }
            // Moods & Genres Section
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(start = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16, top = AppTheme.spacing.spacing48, end = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
            ) {
                SectionHeader(
                    title = stringResource(R.string.moods_genres),
                    showMore = false,
                    showSupportingText = false,
                    supportingText = stringResource(R.string.discover_music_based_on_your_recent),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
                // Genre Grid
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                ) {
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Blue,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.alternative),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5941_62_3672),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Cyan,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.elite),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5942_62_3675),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Green,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.arabic_hip_hop),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5943_62_3678),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Cyan,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.arabic_indie),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5944_62_3675),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Blue,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.chilling),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5945_62_3672),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Red,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.dance_electronic),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5946_62_3681),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.decades),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5947_62_3669),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Blue,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.driving),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5948_62_3672),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Yellow,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.egyptian),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5949_62_3687),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Red,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.feeling_good),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5950_62_3681),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Purple,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.focus),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5951_62_3684),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Blue,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.french),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5952_62_3672),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Green,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.hip_hop_rap),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5953_62_3678),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Blue,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.indie),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5954_62_3672),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Green,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.iraqi),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5955_62_3678),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Purple,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.islamic),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5956_62_3684),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        label = stringResource(R.string.k_pop),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5957_62_3669),
                    )
                    GenreCard(
                        color = GenreCardColor.Green,
                        label = stringResource(R.string.khaleeji),
                        image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_56_5958_62_3678),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
